paragraphs: Apple has teamed up with the American Academy of Pediatrics (AAP) to launch a new guide to “help families create healthy digital habits.”
The new guide follows Apple’s launch of a range of new child safety features in iOS 27.
Apple says this new guide is meant to help families balance screen time with sleep, exercise, schoolwork, and socialization.
You can find the new guide, “Building Healthy Digital Habits: A Guide for Families,” on Apple’s website.
